device.category: 8-voice bi-timbral hybrid wavetable synthesizer, 49 keys with velocity and channel aftertouch
device.based_on: PPG Wave 2.2 / 2.3 (Wolfgang Palm, 1982-84); released 2024 after four years in development (announced as the 'BBG Wave').

sources.note: 49 keys with channel aftertouch; V2044A (SSM2044 clone) 24 dB filter; 30 factory wavetables of 64 waves; 64 user wavetables (23 filled); 32 transients; dimensions and weight.

architecture.polyphony_mode: two sounds per program (groups A and B); ten keyboard modes: Poly 8, Quad (4 x A+B layered), Duo, Mono unison, Quad A/B split, mono/quad/poly split combinations, and A poly with B mono on CV/gate
architecture.patch_memory_note: 200 programs (2 banks of 100), each with group A and B sounds and a sequence; 64 user wavetables and 32 transients loaded via SynthTribe.
architecture.summary: Per voice: a MAIN and a SUB digital oscillator reading the same wavetable (64 waves; WAVES OSC and WAVES SUB set positions; the last four waves of PPG tables are saw, pulse, square and triangle), or a transient (short sample, 128/2048/8192 samples). The sub can follow the main, use its own waves, be off, sync or ring-modulate the main, or become noise. The summed digital signal feeds an analogue 24 dB resonant low-pass (V2044A) and an analogue VCA. EG 1 (ADSR) sweeps the filter and the wavetable, EG 2 (ADSR) is loudness, EG 3 (attack/decay with attenuation) bends pitch or sweeps waves. One LFO (four shapes, 0.2-12 Hz, delay). Behaviour is set in PPG-style numeric menus (Digital, Tuning). Stereo BASIS spread, eight individual voice outputs, polyphonic sequencer, two arpeggiators.

modules.name: Keyboard, groups and keyboard modes
modules.description: 49 keys (velocity, channel aftertouch), octave -2..+1; groups A/B; ten keyboard modes and split point; CV/gate drive group B monophonically in mode 9.

modules.name: Main oscillator
modules.description: Digital wavetable oscillator: position 00-63 in the selected wavetable (or transient start point); 8-bit (2.2) or enhanced (2.3) quality; keyboard, EG 1, EG 3, LFO, wheel, aftertouch and bend can move the position.

modules.name: Sub oscillator
modules.description: Second digital oscillator on the same wavetable: follows the main waves, uses its own WAVES SUB position, swaps EG 1 for EG 3, off, sync source for the main, ring modulator, or noise.

modules.name: Digital sum / DAC
modules.description: Main and sub summed digitally and converted to analogue, without level controls (apart from the noise mode).

modules.name: VCF
modules.description: Analogue 4-pole 24 dB/oct resonant low-pass (Cool Audio V2044A, SSM2044 clone).

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Analogue VCA under EG 2; ENV 2 LOUDNESS sets the group's level.

modules.name: EG 1 (filter / waves)
modules.description: ADSR to filter cutoff (ENV 1 VCF) and wavetable position (ENV 1 WAVES); attack above 47 completes even if the key is released.

modules.name: EG 2 (loudness)
modules.description: ADSR on the VCA (same attack-completion behaviour above 47).

modules.name: EG 3 (pitch / waves)
modules.description: Attack/decay with attenuation: bipolar on pitch (5 = none), or 0-63 wave steps added to WAVES SUB.

modules.name: LFO
modules.description: Triangle, ramp, sawtooth or square, 0.2-12 Hz, with delay (up to 10 s); to waves, filter, loudness and pitch per the menus.

modules.name: Sequencer and arpeggiators
modules.description: Polyphonic step sequencer (record, rest/tie, append, clear last, overdub, transpose) and two arpeggiators (up, down, up/down, random, moving); 40-240 BPM or MIDI/USB/analogue clock.

modules.name: Outputs
modules.description: BASIS spreads notes between channel 1 and 2 (alternating at maximum, mono at minimum); MASTER VOLUME; eight individual voice outputs also keep feeding the mains; headphones.

parameters.function: Modulation per MW/MF/ML/TM settings; position stored per preset and group.

parameters.label: DTF: Data transfer function
parameters.function: Copy edit buffers, initialise (keeps user wavetables) or store (9).

parameters.label: FIRM: Firmware emulation
parameters.function: Original, or enhanced with linear or exponential envelopes.

parameters.label: UW: Upper wavetable
parameters.function: Wavetable: wrap, best-of tables 1-30, no wrap. Transient: 128, 2048 or 8192 samples.

parameters.label: KW: Keyboard control of wavetable
parameters.function: Off; higher notes take higher waves; own wave per note (with skips).

parameters.label: MW: Wavetable modulation
parameters.function: Off; LFO via wheel; wheel sweeps waves; LFO sweeps waves (3-9).

parameters.label: MF: Filter modulation
parameters.function: Off; LFO via wheel; wheel to frequency; wheel to emphasis; LFO depths (4-9).

parameters.label: BD: Pitch bend destination
parameters.function: Off, oscillators, filter, wavetable, sub only, and combinations.

parameters.label: BI: Pitch bend range
parameters.function: 2 semitones, major third, fifth, octave, two octaves, octave stepped.

parameters.label: MO: Main oscillator pitch modulation
parameters.function: LFO vibrato on the main oscillator (via the mod wheel) off/on.

parameters.label: TW: Aftertouch to waves
parameters.function: Off, wavetable sweep, LFO waveform modulation.

parameters.label: TF: Aftertouch to filter
parameters.function: Off, frequency, LFO modulation of frequency.

parameters.label: TL: Aftertouch to loudness
parameters.function: Off, loudness, LFO modulation of loudness.

parameters.label: DETU: Sub detune
parameters.function: 0 none, 1-4 slight to strong, 5 +5 semitones, 6 +1 octave, 7 +2 octaves, 8 -1 octave, 9 -2 octaves.

parameters.label: MS: Sub pitch modulation
parameters.function: LFO vibrato on the sub off/on.

parameters.label: EO: EG 3 to main pitch
parameters.function: 0 off, 1 on, 2-9 polyphonic portamento with increasing glide time.

parameters.label: SEMIT: Voice semitone detune
parameters.function: Upward semitone offset per voice (eight values): 0-63 entered manually, or 0-48 from the keyboard; used e.g. to put group B an octave or two above A.

parameters.label: CLK: Clock source and rate
parameters.function: Internal, DIN, USB or analogue; 1 pulse per step, 2, 24 or 48 ppqn.

parameters.label: OVP: Overdub / transposition
parameters.function: Overdub on/off; transpose sequence or keyboard independent.

parameters.label: MOD: Mode
parameters.function: Sequencer, arpeggiator 1 or 2; up, down, up/down, random, moving.

ports.label: CHANNEL 1 OUTPUT
ports.function: Left (or mono with BASIS at minimum).

ports.label: CHANNEL OUTPUTS 1-8
ports.function: Individual voice outputs (voices still feed the mains).
ports.note: Eight jacks, modelled as one port.

ports.label: CV IN
ports.function: 1 V/oct, -5 to +5 V; plays group B monophonically in keyboard mode 9 (calibratable).

ports.label: GATE IN
ports.function: Gate for the envelopes in keyboard mode 9.

ports.label: EXPRESSION PEDAL
ports.function: Expression pedal (e.g. FC600), voltage on tip; per EXP-PED.

ports.label: USB
ports.function: Class-compliant MIDI; firmware, wavetables and transients via SynthTribe.

connections.note: EG 3 adds 0-63 wave steps to WAVES SUB.
Ring mod and noise modes also arrive here.
Eight voices, spread by BASIS; each also to its own output.

indicators.label: LCD DISPLAY
indicators.function: 2 x 40 characters: program, menus and values.

indicators.label: OLED DISPLAY
indicators.function: Oscilloscope of the output; calibration; wavetable/transient names; SynthTribe transfer confirmation.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Per voice: main and sub wavetable oscillators summed digitally, converted to analogue, into the V2044A 24 dB low-pass and analogue VCA; eight voices spread by BASIS and available at individual outputs.

behaviours.name: Wavetables and transients
behaviours.rule: Each wavetable has 64 waves (PPG tables end with saw, pulse, square, triangle); WAVES OSC/SUB pick positions and EG 1, EG 3, keyboard, LFO, wheel, aftertouch, bend or pedal move them. With a transient, WAVES set start points and ENV 1 WAVES the loop point; UW sets 128, 2048 or 8192 samples.

behaviours.name: Sub oscillator roles
behaviours.rule: SW: follow the main's waves, own waves, swap EG 1 for EG 3, off, sync source for the main, ring modulator, or noise generator.

behaviours.name: Groups and keyboard modes
behaviours.rule: Every program holds sounds A and B. KEYB 0 plays one group with 8 voices; 1 layers A and B with 4 voices; 2 duo; 3 mono unison; 4 splits A (right) and B (left) at SPLT; 5-8 mix mono/quad/poly per side; 9 plays A polyphonically and B monophonically from CV/gate. GROUP chooses what the panel edits (both when both LEDs are lit).

behaviours.name: Envelopes
behaviours.rule: EG 1 and EG 2 are ADSR; attack above 47 completes even after key release (for sweeps). EG 3 is attack/decay with attenuation (bipolar for pitch). FIRM chooses original or enhanced linear/exponential envelopes.

behaviours.name: Sequencer and arpeggiators
behaviours.rule: Polyphonic step recording with rest/tie, append, clear last, overdub and transpose; arpeggiator 1 or 2 with up, down, up/down, random, moving; clock internal 40-240 BPM, DIN, USB or analogue (1 per step to 48 ppqn); saved with the program.

receives.note: panel: 12-14 LFO, 15-17 EG 3, 18-21 EG 1, 22-25 EG 2, 26/27 waves osc/sub, 28 ENV 1 VCF, 29 ENV 2 loudness, 30 ENV 1 waves, 31 group, 71 emphasis, 74 cutoff (per PAR-COM)
120 all sound off, 121 reset controllers, 123 all notes off
MSB 0, LSB 0-46: program, user, digital and tuning menu parameters, per-voice SEMIT (33-40), arp/seq state, mode, clock, gate, division, BPM

preset (121 values), edit buffer, sequencer (578 values), global (20 values) dumps; calibration; user wavetable/transient transfer (16-byte name + 128 x 16-bit PCM, 7-bit packed to 309 bytes); slot name list

midi.note: From the manual's MIDI CC and NRPN tables (pages 34-36). Panel controls use CCs; menu parameters use NRPNs.

specifications.wavetables: 30 factory (64 waves each), 64 user (23 preloaded), 32 user transients
specifications.wavetable_format: 64 waves x 128 samples; imported as 8- or 16-bit via SynthTribe
specifications.sequencer: 64 steps, up to 8 notes per step, per program
calibration: VCA/VCF (hold ANALOG + GROUP at power-up, about 200 s)

source_inconsistencies: The BD (pitch bend destination) list repeats options 6 and 7 with meanings ('one octave detune', 'two octave detune') that belong with the detune settings.
Keyboard modes 7 and 9 are both 'A poly, B mono' (9 adds CV in).
The DIV list includes '1/18 note triplet', presumably 1/8.
Retailers give 8- and 16-bit resolution; Gearspace and MusicRadar say 8- and 12-bit (Wave 2.2 and 2.3 modes).
The cover calls it 'Multi-Timbral'; it is bi-timbral (groups A and B).
The full manual's BD list is correct (0-7); the repeated 6/7 detune entries are a quick start guide error.

Transient slots: the panel text says 'transient (31-63)'; the program menu says 31 is a preset transient and 32-63 are user transients. The preloaded wavetables are said to be in 'slots 64-83' but the list runs to 86.
The ManualsLib edition says the transient loop size is fixed at 128 samples; firmware 1.0.11 adds 128, 2048 and 8192.

Troubleshooting says 'make sure ENV1->Loudness is not zero' (it is ENV 2) and refers to MO/SO/EO/ES 'in the Digital menu' (they are in Tuning, and SO is MS); it also calls master volume control (1) rather than (2).
The filter modulation list gives aftertouch as 'Option TL' (filter aftertouch is TF).
The glossary describes '64 128 bit waveshapes' (128-sample waves).
The NRPN notes say 'ParNum = 0 - 37' but the table runs to 46 (SEMIT V1-V8 33-40, then arp/seq 41-46).
The MIDI tables call MW, MF and ML 'Mod Wheel ->' modulation; the menu text defines M as LFO modulation (with the wheel as one option). ES is labelled 'Env3 -> Main Sub Pitch'.
The DIV range in the sequencer is labelled 'Sequencer Time' and BPM 'Speed (MSB/LSB)', though its 40-240 range exceeds a single 7-bit value.
SynthTribe offers 8- or 16-bit import, matching retailers' '8- and 16-bit'; the '12-bit' figure appears only in press coverage.

modelling_gaps.detail: Panel and menu parameters apply to the selected group (A, B or both); modelled once with group selection as a parameter.
PPG-style numeric menus set many routings; connections show their main effects.
CC and NRPN numbers come from the July 2022 manual; later firmware (1.0.11) may add parameters not in these tables (e.g. FIRM option 2).
